run_crystal_structure_relaxation: run crystal structure relaxation on CIF files from a parquet file using the UMA ML potential with argparse CLI
create_calculator: create a FAIRChemCalculator with a pretrained UMA model predictor for OMC or OMol task-based structure relaxation
relax_atoms: relax a single ASE Atoms crystal structure using BFGS, FIRE, or LBFGS optimizers with optional cell relaxation and symmetry constraints
relax_atoms_batch: relax multiple ASE Atoms structures in a single batch using FairchemLBFGS with optional unit cell optimization
run_relax_jobs: submit parallel SLURM jobs via submitit to relax crystal structures from parquet files across multiple GPU ranks
